'''Red Three''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] used by a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] who flew in [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] during the [[Recapture of Tythe]]. Red Three [[Death/Legends|died]] during the battle.<ref name="Labyrinth" />
